"""Replayable telemetry validation pipeline for one stream.

A stream owns independent state: measured counters, demands, the active routing
plan, the process-local repair cache and the frozen snapshots.  Events are the
only way that state moves, and every answer is derived from the replay policy in
PROTOCOL.md, never from wall-clock or filesystem state.
"""

from .common_utils import Topology, Plan, is_int, UNIT, WEIGHT_TOTAL
from .dtp import RepairEngine
from .snapshot_cache import RepairCache, SnapshotStore, normalize_inputs
from .validate import Validator

CELL_FIELDS = frozenset(("perturbed", "ground_truth", "corrected", "confidence"))
CELL_ALLOWED = frozenset(("perturbed",)) | CELL_FIELDS

    """Unified repair/validation pipeline for a single topology."""

        self.topology = Topology(topology)
        self.repairer = RepairEngine(self.topology)
        self.validator = Validator(self.topology)

        self.seed = settings["seed"]

        self.gamma = _fraction(settings["gamma"])
        self.bias = settings["bias"]
        self.tau = settings["tau"]
        self.counters = {}          # counter key -> reported integer
        self.demands = {}           # (src, dst) -> integer
        self.plan = None            # Plan or None
        self.plan_identity = None
        self.cache = RepairCache(settings["cache_slots"])
        self.snapshots = SnapshotStore()
        self._loads = None
        self._loads_key = None
        self._dirty = True
